field.passwordHelp: Leave empty for AD login. Min 8 characters — only for accounts without AD (e.g. break-glass admin).
field.positionHelp: Synced from AD at each login. Approval: {positions}

revoke.title: Sign {name} out of all devices?
revoke.text: Their current sessions stop working right away; they can log in again. Setting a new local password does this too.

departments.intro: Code is a short unique key (e.g. SYS, PRD), saved in upper case. Used for each user's Department / Section in Users & Roles. Renaming updates the users that have it; inactive entries are hidden from the list.
departments.title: Departments

types.intro: The code is used in the Project Code ({token} token), e.g. SYS-WEB-2026-001.
types.title: Project Types

templates.intro: Templates define the default activities (User Control Plan), default internal tasks and milestones created when a request is converted.
templates.title: Project Templates

tokens.seq: Running number, n digits — restarts for each new prefix
tokens.hover: Hover a token to see what it does

projectCode.title: Project Code
projectCode.description: How new project codes are generated. Request numbers are set per document type in Admin → Document Types.

problem.name: name is required
problem.seq: the request number format needs a {token} running number
problem.clash: the request number format gives the same numbers as {name} — use {token} or another prefix
problem.criterion: every AI criterion needs a name

docTypes.title: Document Types
docTypes.description: Each document type has its own request number (running number) and approval route

field.name: Name
field.continues: numbering continues where it left off for the same prefix

route.title: Approval Route
route.description: The steps every {name} goes through, in order. Changes apply to requests submitted from now on.

hint.requestor: Anyone at that position or higher in the requestor's own department (positions come from AD).
hint.receive: Receives the request and fills in Project Type / Template / Project Leader.
hint.authority: Pick one or more people per step — whoever acts first completes it.

criteria.title: AI Clarification Criteria
criteria.description: What the team needs to know about a project at request time. When the requestor submits, the AI chats with them about what the form does not cover yet — required ones first, optional ones only when they apply — then the requestor confirms a summary per criterion. No criteria = no AI chat.
criteria.none: No criteria — requests are submitted without AI questions
criteria.name: Name
criteria.hint: What to find out — guides the AI's question

docTypes.needApprovers: Requests can't be submitted until every step has an approver

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.text: This holiday will be removed from the company calendar.

workingDays.weekDescription: Days the company works. Template activities at Convert and delay / schedule variance count only working days.
workingDays.custom: Custom work week set in the database — pick one to replace it.

notificationRules.intro: Recipients are resolved per event from the Project Team roles. “Directly involved person” = task owner, approver, requestor, activity PIC. Overdue reminders repeat every N days and escalate to more roles (e.g. Manager) after N days overdue.
notificationRules.title: Notification Rules

insightRules.intro: Smart Insight rules (PRD §22). Set the X thresholds, severity and on/off. Internal rules are only shown to the System Service team.
insightRules.title: Insight Rules

kpi.title: Fair individual KPI
kpi.intro: Late tasks whose Delay Category is in this list are excused — they are not counted against the owner's on-time rate, overdue count or average delay (e.g. waiting for the user or an external vendor). PRD §23.
